name: Midnight Rogues
storyline:
It was supposed to be a simple delivery. Three rogues bring a sealed package to a laboratory, unaware that it contains a bomb or that the scientists inside are developing a substance capable of turning ordinary people into superheroes.

Deadly chemicals spill into the city when the bomb detonates, killing countless people. The three couriers should have died too, but exposure to the experimental substance transformed them, giving them superpowers that saved their lives.

Now blamed for the disaster and hunted by the city, they are approached by a mysterious Wizard with a plan to take down its corrupted superheroes. He gives them one crucial advantage: a time loop that brings them back to the beginning of the fight whenever they die. Every defeat is another chance to return, rebuild, and hit harder.
summary: Midnight Rogues brings item placement and auto-battler combat to the roguelike deckbuilder formula. Choose one of three disgraced young superheroes, buy and rearrange items to build game-breaking combinations, and hunt down The City’s corrupted heroes.
